thread:
neal: quick proposal: move to a tiered-affinity routing model (premium/dedicated, standard/soft, pooled/best-effort) + orthogonal compliance flags (region_pin, model_pin). compose at request-time to avoid N-permutations of slices. thoughts?

tara: sounds promising. product needs concrete launch criteria before we commit roadmap cycles.

sam: runtime concerns: splitting lanes will fragment KV cache. propose reserved hot-cache for premium tenants or warm-up tokens during migration. need simulation data.

devin: prioritization gates idea: 1) cost model that shows positive unit economics, 2) at least 2 paying pilot customers for premium, 3) policy-eval latency target (median <5ms) for request path.

claire: ops points: eviction and fallback must be deterministic. runbook snippet: `evacuate --slice S --grace 180 --drain-concurrency 4` followed by redirect + alert to oncall/CS. also require chaos tests for eviction path.

neal: pilot plan: Pilot-Premium = 2 paid customers on dedicated regional slices; Pilot-Standard = 8-12 tenants on shared pools with soft-affinity. Metrics: p50/p95/p99 per-tenant, cache hit-rate, tokens/100k cost, migration cold-start incidents. Launch criteria (proposed): premium p95 within 12% of dedicated baseline; premium availability >= 99.95%; cost delta <= 25% of projection; migration friction <= X onboarding tickets.

tara: product asks: console toggles to set tier and region_pin, migration grace window, billing hold during migration to avoid double-charge. CS must be able to flip flags quickly.

sam: rough dev estimate: policy engine + compact grammar = 3 sprints; runtime pooling + cache deals = 2 sprints; metrics/alerts + rollout automation = 1 sprint. Pilot + analysis = 1 sprint. total ~7 sprints with parallel work.

ops-bot: Event created: "tiered-affinity routing follow-up" Wed 10:00am (30m)  attendees: neal, tara, sam, devin, claire

neal: action items: @devin run cost model, @sam simulate KV cache impact with 60/30/10 split, @claire draft evacuation playbook, @tara gather customer pricing commitments. follow-up Wed 10am. thanks :thumbsup:
